chosen.title: girl stretching her neck before practicing yoga
chosen.why: Tight close-up of a woman pulling her head sideways with her hand, neck fully lengthened; warm natural light, soft bokeh background, eyes closed (no camera-facing smile), no text/logo. At 4.6s the hand has just landed on the head and the side stretch is at its apex, so 'neck' reads instantly. 16:9 1080p.

alternates.why: Young woman doing a side neck stretch with hand behind her back; sofa/plants home interior. Readable, but dark moody lighting and a wider framing make the neck less prominent than 5065.
Older woman gripping a sore neck with head tilted; clean close-up, but reads as pain rather than a stretch, plain white studio backdrop feels staged, and only 720p was available.

notes: Searched: neck stretch, neck pain, stretching neck office (0 results), woman touching neck (0 results), neck, stretching office. Downloaded 5065, 32630, 32629, 33026. 32629 rejected: front view mostly looking down, side stretch barely visible. First-side peak of 5065 also usable at in_point 0.0 if the editor wants a left-tilt instead.
